posts.title: Online conformal inference for multi-step time series forecasting
posts.description: We study the construction of distribution-free prediction intervals for multi-step time series forecasting. posts.title: The future of scholarly books
posts.description: On Monday, I took part in a Springer Nature roundtable on “The Future of Scholarly Books”, held in Melbourne. Around the table were publishers, librarians and authors.
